highlights: See environment variable names and sources in separate columns and jump to a variable with Quick search.
Recognize actions by their icons in the Commands menu. In Options, labels sit beside their controls and checkboxes line up.
Start settings exports with all groups and custom color schemes selected.
Manage saved color schemes without switching the active scheme, name newly created schemes, and retain the current fonts when changing schemes.
Set a solid window background in modern color schemes or reset it to restore the original gradient.
See the scan location as breadcrumbs in Space Analyzer, and open pane sources and numbered folder bookmark groups from any workspace pane.
